summary: Steakholder Foods Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing expanded retail distribution of its Perfecta plant-based meat line through KeHE Distributors in the U.S. No special-situation transaction occurred: no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, forced management change, or other corporate event. This is a routine business update regarding product distribution. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, incorporated by reference into registration statements. No deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations are present. There is no risk-arb angle; it is a commercial announcement.
